companyAgentDefinitions.title: UI Builder
companyAgentDefinitions.roleSummary: craft visual interface details, component polish, layout quality, and design fidelity
companyAgentDefinitions.collaborationInstructions: Convert UX intent into concrete screens and hand implementation-ready guidance to frontend.

companyAgentDefinitions.title: Builder
companyAgentDefinitions.roleSummary: implement assigned product slices, integrate changes, and deliver reviewable work
companyAgentDefinitions.collaborationInstructions: Own user-facing implementation and coordinate with UI/UX roles on fidelity gaps.

companyAgentDefinitions.title: Backend Builder
companyAgentDefinitions.roleSummary: implement backend behavior, orchestration logic, APIs, and integration reliability
companyAgentDefinitions.collaborationInstructions: Own service and runtime changes, then hand integration notes to QA and release.

companyAgentDefinitions.title: QA
companyAgentDefinitions.roleSummary: review completed work, verify behavior, run qa checks, and summarize residual risk
companyAgentDefinitions.collaborationInstructions: Review every completed slice and decide whether more remediation is needed before release.

companyAgentDefinitions.roleSummary: coordinate release readiness, final integration checks, operational notes, and delivery handoff
companyAgentDefinitions.collaborationInstructions: Prepare the final slice for CEO approval and call out any operational or release blockers.

issues.description:
CEO planning issue for the company goal.

Company: UltraQA API 회사
Goal: 샌드박스 앱을 더 편하게 만들기
Description:
복잡한 내부 용어를 줄이고 사용자가 바로 이해하는 화면을 검증한다.

Roster:
- CEO: lead strategy, planning, triage, staffing decisions, and final merge approval
  specialties: strategy, triage, merge, escalation
  capabilities: planning, triage, goal-decomposition, review, integration
- Product Strategist: translate company goals into scoped work, requirements, and prioritization guidance
  specialties: product, requirements, roadmap, discovery
  capabilities: goal-decomposition
- Engineering Lead: coordinate architecture, implementation direction, integration planning, and technical delegation
  specialties: architecture, integration, backend, frontend
  capabilities: planning, goal-decomposition, implementation, backend, frontend, integration
- UX Builder: shape product flows, usability, interaction clarity, and user-facing experience
  specialties: ux, research, flows, usability
  capabilities: goal-decomposition, implementation, frontend
- UI Builder: craft visual interface details, component polish, layout quality, and design fidelity
  specialties: ui, design, components, visual polish
  capabilities: implementation, frontend
- Builder: implement assigned product slices, integrate changes, and deliver reviewable work
  specialties: implementation, integration, delivery
  capabilities: triage, goal-decomposition, review, implementation, integration
- Backend Builder: implement backend behavior, orchestration logic, APIs, and integration reliability
  specialties: backend, api, kotlin, orchestration
  capabilities: triage, implementation, backend, integration
- QA: review completed work, verify behavior, run qa checks, and summarize residual risk
  specialties: qa, review, verification, testing
  capabilities: review, qa
- Release Manager: coordinate release readiness, final integration checks, operational notes, and delivery handoff
  specialties: release, ops, integration, delivery
  capabilities: planning, implementation, integration

Responsibilities:
- Break the goal into explicit downstream issues.
- Assign each issue to the best-fit role in the roster.
- Decide dependency order and whether each issue should produce code and a PR.
- Keep review and final CEO approval as separate downstream gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce a structured plan with explicit issues, assignees, dependencies, and PR expectations.
Use the current company roster and goal context when assigning work.
issues.transitionReason: Autonomous CEO planning is disabled, so Cotor used the deterministic fallback planner.

issues.title: Deliver the first implementation slice for "샌드박스 앱을 더 편하게 만들기"
issues.description:
Goal: 샌드박스 앱을 더 편하게 만들기

Role: Backend Builder
Phase: execution
Focus: backend behavior, correctness, and integration reliability

Owned subtasks:
- Deliver the first implementation slice for "샌드박스 앱을 더 편하게 만들기": Own this slice in your branch with extra attention to backend behavior, correctness, and integration reliability.
- Validate the assigned branch outcome: Run targeted checks for your implementation, note regressions, and summarize residual risks.

Shared checklist:
- Keep the branch scoped to the assigned focus while still delivering a usable end-to-end result.
- Validate the changed behavior before finishing and call out any residual risk.

Quality bar:
- Treat the result as something an end user could actually open and judge, not as a placeholder diff.
- Do not satisfy the issue with marker comments, README-only edits, or validation-only artifacts unless the issue explicitly asks for that.
- If this is user-facing UI/web work, deliver a visually coherent result with strong hierarchy, spacing, interaction clarity, and polished states.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep the branch scoped to the assigned focus while still delivering a usable end-to-end result.
